CheckEmail.help: Open the link on this device to finish. It can take a minute, and it may be in your spam folder.

ForgotPassword.body: We will email you a link to choose a new one.
ForgotPassword.sent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.

ResetPassword.errorPassword: Use a new password of at least 8 characters.

Onboarding.title: Welcome
Onboarding.body: Choose your language to get started. You can change it later in Settings.
Onboarding.failed: Could not finish setup. Try again.
Onboarding.walletBody: Where do you keep money? You can add more later.

Add.title: Add
Add.name: Name
Add.incomplete: Enter an amount and pick a category to save.
Add.errorPreview: This is a preview without a database, so nothing can be saved.
Add.needWallet: Add a wallet first, then you can log money in and out.
Add.rateHelp: Use the rate you actually got. You can edit the amount.
Add.moveNeedTwo: You need a second wallet to move money. Add one first.
Add.topUpNew: Adding new money to {wallet}, for example income. To take it from another wallet instead, choose Move.
Add.topUpMove: Adding money to {wallet}. It is taken from the wallet you choose here.
Add.receivedActualHelp: Enter the amount you actually received.
Add.receivedLockedHelp: Calculated amount. Tap Edit to enter what you actually received.
Add.receivedManualHelp: Your actual received amount. Use rate to calculate it again.
Add.receivedNoRateHelp: No calculated rate is available. Tap Edit to enter the amount actually received.

Detail.title: Details
Detail.name: Name
Detail.errorPreview: This is a preview without a database, so nothing can be changed.

Wallets.emptyBody: A wallet holds cash, a bank account or a card in USD, Lebanese pounds (LBP), or new Syrian pounds (SYP).
Wallets.name: Name
Wallets.currencyLocked: The currency can't change once a wallet has transactions.
Wallets.errorPreview: This is a preview without a database, so nothing can be saved.
Wallets.archiveConfirm: Archived wallets are hidden and can't take new transactions. Past transactions stay.
Wallets.archivedHelp: Tap a wallet to restore it.
Wallets.emptyArchived: You have no active wallets. Add a new one, or restore an archived wallet below.
Wallets.deleteConfirm: Delete this wallet permanently? This cannot be undone. Wallets that have transactions cannot be deleted.
Wallets.errorHasTransactions: This wallet has transactions, so it cannot be deleted. Keep it archived instead.
Wallets.errorInUse: A fixed expense, installment or loan still uses this wallet. Reassign it before deleting the wallet.
Wallets.sourceTitle: Where does this money come from?
Wallets.takenHelp: Enter exactly what left that wallet. No exchange rate is assumed.
Wallets.takenSame: The same amount is taken from that wallet.
Wallets.newMoneyHelp: The starting balance is new money. It is not taken from any wallet.

Activity.emptyBody: Log your first expense or income and it will show up here.
Activity.noResultsBody: Try a different search or clear the filters.
Activity.dateOrder: The start date must be before the end date.

Salary.title: Monthly salary
Salary.setBody: Set your salary once. Record it whenever it arrives.
Salary.walletGone: The wallet for your salary is no longer available. Pick another one.
Salary.confirmAlready: You recorded salary on {date}. Confirm only if you received another salary.
Salary.errorPreview: This is a preview without a database, so nothing can be saved.
Salary.errorFailed: Could not add salary. Try again.
Salary.explain: The amount and wallet are saved. Each time you press Got salary, that amount is added to the wallet.
Salary.walletHelp: Your other wallets stay as they are, so money held elsewhere keeps its own balance.
Salary.needWallet: Add a wallet first, then set your salary.
Salary.categoryUnavailable: Create or restore an income category in Settings before recording salary.
Salary.cycleHelp: Each confirmed receipt starts a new installment cycle. Debt balances stay unchanged.
Salary.cycleChanged: Another salary was recorded or removed. Review the latest receipt before confirming again.
Salary.errorUncertain: We could not confirm whether salary was recorded. Retry the same receipt before recording another.

Budgets.overCount: {count, plural, one {# category is over budget} other {# categories are over budget}}
Budgets.emptyBody: Set a monthly limit per category and see how much is left.
Budgets.sheetCopy: Applies to {month} and the months after. Leave empty for no budget.
Budgets.errorPreview: This is a preview without a database, so nothing can be saved.
Budgets.totalTooLarge: The total is too large. Reduce an amount.

Installments.title: Installments
Installments.tooMuch: That is more than what is left ({amount}).
Installments.name: Name
Installments.paidBeforeHelp: What you paid before adding it here. It counts toward the total.
Installments.defaultWalletHelp: Payments come from here unless you pick another wallet of the same currency.
Installments.monthlyHelp: The scheduled amount is included once per salary cycle. Nothing is paid automatically.
Installments.errorPaidBefore: That is more than the total.
Installments.errorPreview: This is a preview without a database, so nothing can be saved.
Installments.errorTotalBelowPaid: The total cannot be less than what you already paid.
Installments.needWallet: Add a wallet first, then add an installment.
Installments.noWalletForCurrency: No active wallet in this currency.
Installments.cycleHelp: Payments stay recorded until you receive salary again.
Installments.initialCycleHelp: Payments here stay recorded until your first salary.
Installments.confirmAgainTitle: Another payment before your next salary?
Installments.confirmAgainBody: This records another expense and reduces the remaining balance. It does not start a new salary cycle.
Installments.cycleChanged: Salary has changed since this sheet opened. Review the latest amounts before paying.
Installments.paymentChanged: Another payment changed. Review the latest installment before paying again.
Installments.alreadyPaid: A payment is already recorded for this salary. Review it before paying again.
Installments.requestAlreadyUsed: This payment was changed or removed. Check Activity before making another.
Installments.errorUncertain: We could not confirm whether this payment was saved. Retry the same payment, or close and check Activity before starting again.
Installments.paymentDateHelp: The date affects Activity and reports. This payment belongs to the salary cycle open when you record it.
Installments.summaryHelp: Fixed expenses follow the month. Installments stay paid until the next salary; partial payments still leave a remainder.
Installments.loadErrorBody: We could not read your payment status. Try again before recording a payment.
Installments.noDuplicateHelp: To reduce the installment balance again, use Pay again under Installments.
Installments.salaryDeleteHelp: Removing this salary returns installments to the previous salary cycle. Existing payments and remaining debt are kept.
Installments.restoreOvercap: This payment cannot be restored because newer payments leave too little remaining. Review the installment first.

Fixed.title: Fixed expenses
Fixed.explain: List monthly costs once and record each payment. Installments follow salary receipts.
Fixed.errorPreview: This is a preview without a database, so nothing can be saved.
Fixed.errorPay: Could not record it. Check that its wallet is still active.
Fixed.name: Name
Fixed.walletHelp: This wallet is reduced each time you press Paid.
Fixed.dueHelp: A reminder only. Nothing is paid automatically.
Fixed.deleteConfirm: Delete this fixed expense? Payments you already recorded stay in Activity.
Fixed.needWallet: Add a wallet first, then add your fixed expenses.

Categories.title: Categories
Categories.intro: Choose the names and tiles you use when logging money.
Categories.empty: No categories yet. Add one to start logging.
Categories.namesHelp: Enter at least one name, up to 40 characters. The other language uses it as a fallback.
Categories.nameLength: Use 40 characters or fewer for each name.
Categories.nameRequired: Enter an English or Arabic name.
Categories.removeCopy: An unused category is deleted. If it has transactions or budgets, it is archived and its history stays. Existing budget limits continue until you clear them in Budgets.
Categories.removeDependencies: Reassign any fixed expenses or installments first. Categories with existing child categories cannot currently be removed.
Categories.catalogueError: Your categories could not be loaded. Try again.
Categories.errorPreview: This is a preview without a database. Your categories have not changed.
Categories.errorDuplicate: An active category already has this name. Use a different name or rename the active category before restoring this one.
Categories.errorInUse: Reassign fixed expenses, installments and loans before removing this category. Categories containing child categories cannot be removed yet.
Categories.errorInvalid: This category has changed or is unavailable. Close this sheet and try again.
Categories.errorUnavailable: Choose an active category or restore this one first.
Categories.errorFailed: Your change could not be saved. Try again.

Breakdown.title: Breakdown
Breakdown.exceedsTotal: Items exceed the expense total. Reduce the items or update the total.
Breakdown.invalidItem: Complete every item or remove its row.
Breakdown.maxItems: You can add up to 50 items.
Breakdown.removeBeforeCurrencyChange: To change currency, remove the items and save first.
Breakdown.removeBeforeKindChange: Remove the breakdown before changing the transaction type.
Breakdown.sourceKindLocked: This payment keeps the type of its original source.
Breakdown.conflict: This entry changed. Reload the latest data before trying again.
Breakdown.reloadHint: Reloading discards unsaved changes in this sheet.
Breakdown.unknownOutcome: The connection was interrupted. Retry this save before changing its details.
Breakdown.walletUnavailable: This wallet is unavailable. Choose another active wallet.

MoneyError.title: Amounts unavailable
MoneyError.body: These amounts could not be displayed. Try again.

Cashier.title: Cash paid and change
Cashier.confirmRate: Use this rate for this purchase
Cashier.needWallet: Create an active {currency} wallet to receive change in {currency}.
Cashier.rateError: Enter and confirm the rate for this purchase.
Cashier.mismatch: Purchase cost must equal cash paid minus the value of change. Check the amounts and rate.
Cashier.unsupportedPair: This currency pair cannot be used for change.
Cashier.walletUnavailable: Choose an active wallet for the returned change.
Cashier.removeBeforeKindChange: Turn off cash paid and change before changing the transaction type.
Cashier.rateHelp: This purchase keeps its confirmed rate. Actual change is recorded exactly; conversion rounds once to the paying currency’s smallest unit.

Loans.deleteLoanHelp: This permanently removes the loan and all linked transactions, including the principal movement and payments. Their wallet effects and fee reporting will be reversed. This cannot be undone.
Loans.deletePaymentHelp: This permanently removes this payment and reverses its wallet movement and fee reporting. An active payment's amount returns to the loan balance. Other payments keep their recorded principal and fee amounts. This cannot be undone.
Loans.countHelp: Include the final payment. Enter 1 to 1,200 payments.
Loans.planHelp: Calculated from the original total including the fee. Payments are recorded manually; extra or partial payments can change the last balance. Clear both fields to remove the plan.
Loans.invalidPlan: Enter a monthly amount and 1–1,200 payments that leave a positive final balance.
Loans.suggestMonthly: Monthly amount suggested. You can change it for this payment.
Loans.suggestFinal: Final balance suggested. You can change it for this payment.
Loans.title: Loans
Loans.emptyBody: Track money you borrow or lend, with one clear balance.
Loans.name: Name or person
Loans.existingHelp: No wallet movement. Your wallet balances should already include the old cash movement. Paid-before amounts change progress only, not past income or spending.
Loans.noMovement: No money will be added to or taken from a wallet.
Loans.cashIn: Principal will be added to this wallet:
Loans.cashOut: Principal will be taken from this wallet:
Loans.splitHelp: Payments repay principal first, then the one-time fee.
Loans.voidHelp: This reverses its wallet movement and fee reporting. Only the latest active payment can be voided.
Loans.cancelNewHelp: The principal movement will be reversed. Payments must be voided first. History stays linked.
Loans.cancelExistingHelp: This removes the tracked balance without changing a wallet. Payments must be voided first. History stays linked.
Loans.noWallet: Create an active wallet before adding a loan.
Loans.noCategory: Create an active fee category for this direction first.
Loans.noMatchingWallet: No active wallet in this loan’s currency. Restore a wallet or create one before recording a payment.
Loans.invalidPercent: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, with at most two decimals.
Loans.unavailable: Loans could not be loaded. Try again.
Loans.totalsUnavailable: These totals exceed the supported display range. Individual balances are available below.
Loans.termsLocked: Principal, currency and fee are fixed. To correct them, cancel a loan with no active payments and add it again.
Loans.errorPreview: This is a preview without a database. Changes are not saved.
Loans.errorFailed: The change could not be saved. Refresh and try again.
Loans.errorInvalid: Check the details and try again.
Loans.errorConflict: This payment changed in another tab. Refresh the history before trying again.
Loans.errorOrder: A later payment is active, or the original allocation no longer fits. Refresh the history first.
Loans.errorClosed: This loan is canceled. Its payments cannot be changed.
Loans.errorInUse: Void active payments before canceling. Only a fully repaid loan can be archived.
Loans.movementHelp: This amount is the wallet movement. Only the fee counts as income or spending.
Loans.errorUncertain: This entry may have been saved. Keep this form open and retry the exact request before adding another.
